footer_tagline: Open-source tournaments for any game: brackets, match rooms and an API.
api_docs_lead: The REST API lets other programs, such as a Discord bot, run your organization's tournaments. It can do everything the tournament admin pages can.
api_docs_auth_create: Create a key in your organization's admin, on the API keys tab. The key is shown only once, so store it somewhere safe.
api_docs_auth_header: Send it with every request in the Authorization header. Request and response bodies are JSON, so send Content-Type: application/json, also on requests without a body.
api_docs_auth_scope: A key acts for its organization: tournaments of other organizations are not found. Anyone holding it has the same access as an admin, so keep it on your server.
api_docs_errors_lead: Every error has the same shape. Invalid requests also list each problem in issues.
api_docs_spec_lead: Every endpoint is also described in a machine-readable form, for generating clients:
validation_name_max: Name must be at most {max} characters.
validation_description_max: Description must be at most {max} characters.
validation_slug_min: Address must be at least {min} characters.
validation_slug_max: Address must be at most {max} characters.
validation_slug_format: Address may only contain lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.
validation_username_min: Username must be at least {min} characters.
validation_username_max: Username must be at most {max} characters.
validation_username_format: Username may only contain lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
validation_display_name_max: Display name must be at most {max} characters.
validation_bio_max: Bio must be at most {max} characters.

home_lead: Tournament Manager is an open-source tournament platform for any game. You set up the draw, players report their own scores, and everyone follows the same bracket, live.
home_joint_label: An example match: report the score and the winner takes the screen.
home_format_single_elimination: Lose once and you are out. The top seeds get the byes.
home_format_double_elimination: Lose twice and you are out, with a bracket reset if the grand final needs one.
home_format_round_robin: Everyone plays everyone, once or twice.
home_format_swiss: Equal scores meet each round, and nobody plays the same opponent twice.
home_formats_stages: Play one, or groups first and a final stage after.
home_feature_reports_on: Two matching reports decide the match. A mismatch goes to the organizer's queue.
home_feature_requirements_on: For example, a TETR.IO rank of S or higher, checked when players register.
home_feature_stages: Play groups first, then a final stage.
home_feature_stages_on: For example, two groups of four, with the top two of each going into double elimination.
home_feature_api: Let a bot run it through the API.
home_feature_api_on: 29 operations, one key per organization, documented as OpenAPI 3.1.
home_feature_live: Everyone follows the same bracket, live.
home_feature_live_on: Results and chat arrive without reloading the page.
home_close_lead: Free and open source. Host it yourself with Docker, or use your club's instance.
home_roster_lead: Players register themselves. Set a limit, require a linked game account, and watch the open places fill.
